dependency_semantics: integration acceptance; coding against contracts may start earlier

issues.title: [P0][DB] Introduce canonical migrations, identity and evidence snapshots
scope: Create versioned migrations for shared identity, goal/profile snapshots, normalized skills and immutable job/search/gap evidence.
Reconcile main/database with conflicting agent-owned tables; provide an explicit legacy-data migration strategy.
Enforce ownership in repositories and private-file metadata; preserve source origin and retrieval timestamps.
acceptance: Clean install and migration from reviewed main both pass on an isolated database; no destructive implicit reset.
Alias normalization is unique and consistent; cached snapshots keep original retrieval times and excerpts.
Cross-user references cannot be inserted/read; confirmed snapshots are immutable.
Legacy model-reviewed evidence remains nonconforming rather than silently becoming verified v0.1 evidence.
issues.start: Start immediately from data-model.yaml; agree repository signatures with AF-01.

issues.title: [P0][DB] Persist reviewed templates, frozen rubrics and private test sets
scope: Add immutable template versions, reviewer records, rubric versions, test-set registration and private assets.
Implement publication gates and exact path/template/rubric/test-set relationships.
acceptance: Self-review, mismatched content hashes, incomplete checks and missing diagnostic/final sets block publication.
Published content and registered test bundles cannot be edited in place; alternate sets require independent review.
Path and attempt bindings cannot cross template/rubric versions.
Learner and model-gateway roles cannot read private expected answers.
issues.start: Design migrations/repositories now; integrate on DB-01.

issues.title: [P0][DB] Implement durable workflows, idempotency and atomic assessment evidence
scope: Separate workflow operations from resumable journey state; add idempotency records, worker leases and outbox.
Persist learning sessions, attempts, grader artifacts and verified evidence with terminal-result guards.
acceptance: Identical repeated writes return the same result; changed request under the same key returns 409.
Concurrent workers and crash recovery produce one domain effect and increment failed-attempt count once.
Only final passed attempts with matching owner/skill/rubric/artifacts can atomically create verified evidence.
Diagnostic, failed and needs_review outcomes cannot create mastery; retry limits persist across restarts.
issues.start: Define transactional repository interfaces now; integrate after schema/template foundations.

issues.title: [P0][DB] Version résumé approvals, private exports and account deletion
scope: Add exact revision/hash approvals, evidence-linked changes and per-format immutable export records.
Implement storage staging/outbox cleanup, user-data export and deletion including owned files.
acceptance: An edit atomically clears approval and increments revision; stale approval/export requests fail.
PDF and DOCX can coexist for the same approved revision; duplicate export returns the same artifact.
Storage/DB failures clean orphan bytes without losing committed artifacts.
Deletion removes owned rows/files and retains only the documented minimal status tombstone; signed links expire.
issues.start: Design approval/storage transactions now; integrate after DB-03 evidence records.

issues.title: [P0][Agent] Build canonical API, authenticated ownership and workflow orchestration
scope: Implement /api/v1 FastAPI conventions, Supabase JWT validation, consent checks and shared repository adapters.
Return standard errors and 202 workflow envelopes; expose typed result retrieval and journey resume.
Replace agentic-fw startup SQL/table initialization with shared repositories.
acceptance: JWT issuer/audience/signature/expiry are checked; X-User-Id is not accepted as identity.
Cross-user IDs return 404; reviewer-only routes verify server-side role.
Slow operations consistently return 202; queued/running/completed/failed states follow the contract.
Backend response examples validate against OpenAPI; no conflicting schema initialization remains.
issues.start: Implement routing/auth and repository interfaces now; use isolated test repositories until DB-01 integrates.

issues.title: [P0][Agent] Add interchangeable OpenAI and Nebius model gateway
scope: Replace direct provider-client construction with provider-neutral generate_json/generate_text adapters.
Implement model-routing config, pinned routing revisions, capability reports, bounded retries and redacted invocation metadata.
Keep model credentials and routing outside browser APIs and competency definitions.
acceptance: Configured OpenAI and Nebius models pass the same task/schema/business conformance fixtures.
Missing/expired/mismatched capability reports block routes; malformed/refused/truncated outputs never mutate domain state.
Changing active profile affects new workflows only; invocation records identify actual provider/model.
Fallback-off makes no requests to the other provider; enabled fallback stays within explicit allowed profiles.
Neither provider can publish templates, modify grading keys, award mastery or approve exports.
issues.start: Start immediately using gateway unit tests and configured provider test accounts; do not commit credentials.

issues.title: [P0][Agent] Complete profile intake, job retrieval and evidence-backed gap analysis
scope: Implement PDF/DOCX/manual profile intake, experience/skill correction and confirmation.
Implement provider adapter, filters, deduplication, immutable snapshots and honest fallback behavior.
Normalize skills and rank supported gaps; distinguish credentials/experience barriers and template availability.
acceptance: Malformed/unreadable uploads produce safe errors and manual-entry recovery; source excerpts are verified.
Search cannot bypass profile confirmation/consent; all result records belong to the journey.
Real success, zero results, partial descriptions, outage/rate-limit and stale cache have explicit labeled outcomes.
Every ranked gap cites matching requirements in the selected snapshots; required/preferred and unknown evidence remain distinct.
Equivalent skill profiles with different irrelevant personal details receive equivalent rankings.
issues.start: Build adapters and extraction fixtures against shared schemas now; integration depends on identity, gateway and DB foundations.

issues.title: [P0][Agent] Implement template review, supported pathways and curated resources
scope: Implement reviewer-only template/test-set registration and publication APIs.
Resolve gaps to compatible published templates and generate bounded paths with pinned rubric/version.
Implement reviewed-catalog-first resource discovery and supplements; prepare two real reviewed competency packages.
acceptance: Unreviewed/self-approved/hash-mismatched/invalid templates cannot publish; real reviewers and resource records replace fixtures.
Two distinct competencies, at least one non-RAG, use common workflow logic; unsupported gaps never substitute RAG.
Concept graph/references, registered handlers, grading coverage and practice/final separation are validated.
Resources expose access labels and verification time; at most five free/five paid and no padded recommendations.
Learner path approval is distinct from template publication and pins the exact reviewed rubric.
issues.start: Implement resolver, review validation and resource contracts now; coordinate content review while AF-03 is built.

issues.title: [P0][Agent] Build learning, diagnostics and independent deterministic assessment
scope: Implement lessons/tutor, optional placement diagnostic and registered bounded activity handlers.
Execute reviewed knowledge/project graders, freeze attempt assignments and persist reproducible artifacts.
Implement remediation, fresh-test allocation and honest needs_review behavior.
acceptance: Diagnostic and practice never award mastery; final grading uses server-owned rules and ignores client scores.
Known passing/failing/ungradable cases produce expected outcomes; any failed critical criterion blocks passing.
Final tasks differ from practice and prior disclosed attempts; keys remain private; hints are blocked during final attempts.
One atomic final-pass transaction creates evidence; retries cannot duplicate results or exceed the configured cap.
No arbitrary code/network execution; activity resource/time limits are enforced.
issues.start: Implement registered executors/graders and failure fixtures now; integrate against DB-03 and reviewed packages from AF-04.

issues.title: [P0][Agent] Generate supported résumé diffs and approved PDF/DOCX exports
scope: Generate suggested changes from confirmed background and owned verified evidence.
Implement revision-aware edit/approve/reject/export routes, document rendering and fresh signed download links.
acceptance: Every new achievement traces to allowed evidence; invented employer/credential/years/production claims are rejected.
Manual wording edits are revalidated; an edit clears approval; stale hashes cannot export.
Readable PDF and DOCX artifacts contain exactly approved content; retries reuse existing exports.
Renewing a signed URL never changes document bytes; unauthorized download is rejected.
issues.start: Build renderer and claim-validation fixtures now; integration needs verified evidence and DB-04 approval transactions.

issues.title: [P0][UI] Integrate typed API client, identity and resumable workflow state
scope: Generate/validate client types from canonical OpenAPI; standardize snake_case and error shapes.
Use Supabase identity SDK, workflow polling and server-backed journey resume instead of local-only progress.
Create schema-valid UI fixtures for parallel screen development.
acceptance: Frontend runs with mocks disabled against canonical API; queued/completed replace incompatible status names.
Polling survives transient errors and refresh without enqueuing duplicate work.
Errors and expired sessions offer useful recovery; local caches are user-scoped and cleared on logout.
No provider keys/settings or client-owned grading decisions appear in public requests.
issues.start: Start immediately against contract fixtures; AF-01 blocks live integration acceptance, not screen/client coding.

issues.title: [P0][UI] Complete goal-first onboarding and sourced Skill Bridge
scope: Build role/filter/objective/modality entry, PDF/DOCX/manual skills, experience review and explicit confirmation.
Build existing/market/gap views with expandable source evidence, provenance and coverage status.
acceptance: Both upload and manual flows work end to end; invalid upload preserves editable manual fields.
Every recommendation exposes source excerpt/link/retrieval time and required/preferred status.
Missing evidence is never presented as lack of competence; credential barriers and unsupported templates are clear.
Keyboard-only completion works with loading, error, empty and fallback states.
issues.start: Build all screen states against schema-valid fixtures now; connect when AF-03 is ready.

issues.title: [P0][UI] Build template-driven pathways, rubric approval and resource selection
scope: Render supported template availability, concepts, milestones, prerequisites and frozen rubric.
Build resource cards and exact-version path approval without competency-specific hardcoding.
acceptance: Two distinct template definitions render through common UI logic; no RAG fallback.
Unsupported/unreviewed prerequisites cannot be bypassed to start a verified pathway.
Resource free/paid/mixed/unknown labels, verification times and ranking reasons are visible.
Approval submits displayed path revision and rubric hash; stale state prompts refresh/review.
issues.start: Build reusable views from the example schemas; do not represent draft fixtures as reviewed content.

issues.title: [P0][UI] Build diagnostic, learning arena and independent assessment
scope: Build lessons/tutor, placement diagnostic, registered activity renderers and independent final submissions.
Show separate knowledge/project outcomes, criterion feedback, remediation and needs_review.
acceptance: Learner can skip diagnostic; practice/hints never display as mastery.
Final assessment omits hints and answer keys, submits work only, and displays server outcomes.
Refresh resumes the correct attempt without duplicate submission; retry exhaustion has a clear next action.
Keyboard interaction and error recovery work for both initial activity families.
issues.start: Build registered renderers and all result states from fixtures now; AF-05 supplies live execution.

issues.title: [P0][UI] Build evidence-linked progress and résumé review/download
scope: Show persisted competency evidence and scope; render before/after résumé changes and support references.
Implement edit/approve/reject controls, version conflicts and PDF/DOCX download flow.
acceptance: Self-reported, confirmed and demonstrated statuses remain distinct.
User can inspect supporting evidence and edit/reject; approval names the exact displayed revision.
Any edit invalidates approval; stale exports are blocked; both formats download correctly.
Expired links renew through authenticated API without regenerating content; keyboard flow succeeds.
issues.start: Build progress/diff states now using contract fixtures; integrate after AF-06.

issues.title: [P0][Integration] Prove the complete MVP and provider-independent contract conformance
scope: Run the P0 acceptance matrix through the real browser/API/DB with two reviewed competencies.
Record provider, grader, provenance, failure/recovery, privacy, bias and accessibility evidence.
acceptance: All P0 acceptance.csv checks have recorded test evidence and no unresolved release blockers.
Both configured OpenAI/Nebius routes pass capability/task checks; deterministic grading stays unchanged.
Demonstrate live jobs plus outage, missing evidence, unsafe content, cross-user denial and deletion cases.
Complete both competencies through approved PDF/DOCX export with mocks disabled; archive a repeatable runbook.
issues.start: Write tests/runbook early and run incrementally; full acceptance waits for all P0 implementations.

issues.title: [P1][Cross-stream] Add opt-in wellbeing and approved pacing changes
scope: Implement minimal nonclinical check-ins, encouragement and optional pacing/pause requests.
Keep wellbeing data isolated from matching, grading and résumé evidence.
acceptance: Default is off; enabling/disabling is explicit and persisted.
A shorter plan/pause applies only after user confirmation.
Matching/assessment/export results are unchanged for identical inputs with different wellbeing preferences.
issues.start: Schedule after P0 vertical slice passes; current preferences contract can be implemented earlier.
